name: remakecraft
description: Name an app, get a native rewrite. A clean-room pipeline with sealed tests and an honest parity score.

interface.shortDescription: Clean-room rewrites of apps you don't have the source for
interface.longDescription: Inventory an app from its docs, screenshots and recordings, write a behaviour-only spec, generate conformance tests with a sealed holdout before any code, build from the spec alone and score parity honestly. In Codex the clean-room rules are instructions; Claude Code enforces them with hooks.
defaultPrompt: Clone this app for me from its docs and screenshots.
Rebuild this CLI from scratch; I don't have its source.
